user.title: Tapo account
user.description: Sign in with the TP-Link Tapo account that owns the cameras. Your password is used once to obtain a session token and is not stored.

mfa.title: Two-factor verification
mfa.description: Enter the verification code sent to {email}.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored session for {email} expired and could not be renewed.

error.invalid_code: That verification code was not accepted.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tapo cloud. Check this machine's internet connection.
error.mfa_send_failed: Could not request a verification code. Try again shortly.
error.mfa_unsupported: This account needs a second factor that is not supported yet.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: That Tapo account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Tapo Cloud is signed in again.

data_description.snapshot_interval: A snapshot opens a short relay session and decodes a frame, so it is cached for this long.
data_description.relay_host: Change this only if live view fails with a relay error. The default covers ap-southeast-1.
data_description.live_width: Live frames are scaled down to this width, keeping the aspect ratio. 0 keeps the camera's full resolution (2304 px on many models, much more bandwidth).
data_description.live_fps: Maximum frames per second in live view. 0 keeps the camera's own rate (around 14-15 fps).

pan.name: Pan
pan.description: Pan the camera by a relative number of steps. 10 is a nudge, 150 a large sweep.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Positive and negative pan in opposite directions.

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.description: Tilt the camera by a relative number of steps.

move_to_preset.name: Move to preset
move_to_preset.description: Move the camera to one of its saved preset positions.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The preset id, as saved on the camera.

set_privacy_mode.name: Set privacy mode
set_privacy_mode.description: Attempt to turn privacy mode on or off. The Tapo cloud currently rejects setting changes; pan, tilt and presets are unaffected.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether privacy mode should be on.
